name: object-studies
description: Tactile, physical-object React components: Melani (whiteboard), Kimolia (chalkboard), Korniza (gallery frames), Keramos (painted pottery), Kollaz (craft table), Komboloi (worry beads) and Kipos (garden bed).

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:packages && npm run smoke:consumer
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run check:packages && changeset publish
scripts.dev:site: npm run build --workspace object-studies-core --workspace korniza --workspace kimolia --workspace melani --workspace keramos --workspace kollaz --workspace komboloi --workspace kipos && npm run dev --workspace object-studies-site
